title: A kept band wears the worn system's ground with every word of the band still readable; the Design system cards are the site wearing each system
expect: S1: every test passes, including a band ground chosen so each band text reads at 4.5:1 or the template's own level, fill entries outside kept bands, and labels filled with the accent taking readable words.
S2: every test passes: ?tracy_ds_preview=<id> answers the site's page wearing the system, no-store and noindex, writing nothing to the site.
evidence: Before this change a kept band kept the template's whole look under every system: about 90% of the first screen of WordPress Tracy Business looked unchanged after Apply
fence: A band's words keep their colours; only the ground and the template's accent inside it change, and a band with no readable ground stays as it was
